Handover a kind reminder for customers

With that in mind

Travelers, please review companion travel requirements before arrival at Aurelia Skyways. Companions must meet our animal acceptance rules, and paperwork should be ready for inspection. We regret any inconvenience, but these checks help the senior coordinator keep service dependable and safe. <<FACT F073>> Please also confirm crate fit and handling needs in advance. <<FACT F062>> If anything is unclear, kindly contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for prompt guidance and support.
